entryGate.title: Before you start
entryGate.body: IndianPolicy is an independent, non-governmental project. Summaries here are for general information only, not legal advice, and may not reflect the very latest changes to a law.
entryGate.checkboxLabel: I understand this is informational only, not legal advice, and I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

guide.title: Your policy guide
guide.step1: I'm here to help you find the right policy, not a lawyer, not the government, just a quick orientation.
guide.step2: Start from the topic cards on the home page, or search in plain language like "how do I get a ration card".
guide.step3: On "By State", pick your state to see which national and state-specific laws apply to you.
guide.step4: Every summary links to its official source, and can be read aloud in your language. Click me anytime for a refresher.

home.heroTitle: Understand Indian policy, in your language.
home.heroSubtitle: Plain-language summaries of Indian government policies, each linked to official sources you can check yourself. Read it, or listen to it.
home.feature1Desc: Complex policies explained simply, without political spin.
home.feature2Desc: Every entry links to the original government source document or website.
home.feature3Desc: English, Hindi, Tamil, Marathi, Malayalam, Bengali and Kannada.
home.feature4Desc: Built-in text-to-speech reads any summary aloud in your chosen language.
home.topicsTitle: What do you need help with?
home.topicsSubtitle: Start from a real-life situation instead of a legal category, each one links to the actual policies that apply.

topics.welfareDesc: Government schemes, subsidies, and social support you may be entitled to.
topics.jobsDesc: Wages, workplace safety, leave, and your rights as an employee.
topics.familyDesc: Marriage, inheritance, succession, and family-related law.
topics.healthDesc: Public healthcare schemes and rights for persons with disabilities.
topics.educationDesc: Student rights, scholarships, and education policy.
topics.housingDesc: Tenant protections, consumer complaints, and housing schemes.

home.stateTeaserDesc: See which national and state-specific laws apply where you live.

about.title: About IndianPolicy
about.mission: IndianPolicy is an independent, non-governmental project that summarizes Indian government policies in plain language, across 7 Indian languages, with every summary linked back to an official source so readers can verify it themselves.
about.whatWeDo: We write short, neutral, fact-based summaries of public policies, laws and schemes, and link directly to the original government notification, act, or official website for every entry.
about.whatWeDont: We do not take political positions, endorse or criticize any party or leader, offer legal advice, or claim to be a government or officially affiliated source.
about.languages: Available in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Tamil (தமிழ்), Marathi (मराठी), Malayalam (മലയാളം), Bengali (বাংলা) and Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ).
about.tts: Every summary can be read aloud using your browser's built-in speech engine, in the language you're currently viewing. Voice quality depends on your device and operating system.
about.contact: If you spot an error or an outdated source link, please let us know so we can correct it.
about.onePara: IndianPolicy is an independent, non-governmental project that turns Indian central and state laws, checked against official sources, into plain-language summaries in 7 languages, read aloud if you'd rather listen than read, it isn't legal advice, just a starting point so you understand your rights before deciding whether to consult a professional.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Please read this before relying on any content on this site.
disclaimer.nonAffiliation: IndianPolicy is an independent, privately-run project. It is not operated, endorsed, reviewed, or affiliated with the Government of India, any state government, ministry, department, or political party. For authoritative information, always refer to the official government source linked on each page.
disclaimer.notLegalAdvice: Content on this site is provided for general informational and educational purposes only. It is not legal, financial, medical, or professional advice. Do not act or refrain from acting based on this content without seeking advice from a qualified professional and consulting the original official source.
disclaimer.neutrality: We aim to describe policies factually and neutrally, without editorializing about political parties, leaders, or motives. If you believe any content is biased or inaccurate, please contact us.
disclaimer.translation: Summaries in Hindi, Tamil, Marathi, Malayalam, Bengali and Kannada are produced with AI assistance and have not been certified by a professional legal translator. In case of any conflict, the English summary and the linked official government source take precedence.
disclaimer.sources: Every summary links to an official government source. We encourage you to read the original document, as summaries can omit detail or nuance and policies can change after publication.
disclaimer.noWarranty: This site is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose, to the maximum extent permitted by law.
disclaimer.ip: Government works cited or linked here remain the property of the relevant government body under applicable law. We link to and briefly summarize such works under fair-use/fair-dealing principles rather than reproducing them in full; we do not claim ownership of underlying government text.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data this site collects and your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
privacy.dataCollected: In its current demo form, this site does not require account creation or collect personal data through forms. If analytics are enabled in a future version, they would collect only aggregated, non-identifying usage data (e.g. pages visited, language selected) unless stated otherwise.
privacy.ttsPrivacy: The listen/read-aloud feature runs entirely in your browser using your device's built-in speech engine. Text is not sent to a third-party voice server for this feature.
privacy.cookies: This site may use minimal, strictly necessary cookies (for example, to remember your selected language). We do not use cookies for advertising.
privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights under the DPDP Act, 2023
privacy.rights: If personal data is ever collected (for example, via a future contact form), you have the right to access, correct, and request erasure of that data, and to withdraw consent, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Any such data would be processed only for the stated purpose and retained no longer than necessary.
privacy.thirdParty: This site links to official government websites and other external sources. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those external sites.
privacy.contact: For privacy questions or data requests, please reach out via the contact details on the About page.
privacy.updates: We may update this privacy policy as the site evolves. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
